# Fortera Homes — Beechwood Collection

> New two bedroom rental apartments in Beechwood, Ottawa. Now leasing at 82 Genest St (Beechwood South), from $2,300/month, with move-ins Spring 2027.

Beechwood Collection by Fortera Homes is a new 8-unit purpose-built rental building at 82 Genest St in Ottawa's Beechwood South neighbourhood. Every suite is a two bedroom home of 860 to 920 sq ft, with one or two full bathrooms depending on the floor. Suites include in-suite laundry, high ceilings, premium finishes, and a private balcony or patio. The building is now leasing ahead of its Spring 2027 completion.

## The Development

- **Project name:** Beechwood Collection
- **Developer / landlord:** Fortera Homes
- **Address:** 82 Genest St, Ottawa, ON, Canada
- **Neighbourhood:** Beechwood South, Ottawa (at the edge of New Edinburgh)
- **Units:** 8 rental suites, all two bedroom
- **Size range:** 860 to 920 sq ft
- **Rent:** $2,300 to $2,600 per month
- **Status:** Now leasing
- **Estimated move-in:** Spring 2027
- **Lease terms offered:** 1 year, 2 years, or 3 years or more

## Floor Plans & Rent

- **Mackay A / Mackay B** — 2 bed / 1 bath, 860 sq ft, ground floor (units 101, 102) — $2,300/month
- **Manor A / Manor B** — 2 bed / 2 bath, 920 sq ft, 2nd and 3rd floor (units 201, 202, 301, 302) — $2,500/month
- **Rideau A / Rideau B** — 2 bed / 2 bath, 920 sq ft, 4th (top) floor (units 401, 402) — $2,600/month

Floor plans for every unit are on the project page: https://forterahomes.ca/projects/beechwood-collection

## Included in Every Suite

- In-suite washer and dryer
- High ceilings and large windows
- Premium kitchen finishes
- Private balcony or patio
- Internet included (Bell Fiber, over 1 Gbps) for leases signed on or before December 31, 2026 — a $110/month value
- Keyless entry
- HRV ventilation and smart thermostats
- Sound insulation and energy-efficient building systems
- Dedicated storage units and bicycle storage
- Fully accessible units available

## How to Apply

1. Apply online at https://forterahomes.ca/register (about one minute).
2. The Fortera team follows up with availability and answers to questions.
3. Approved applicants choose their floor and unit. Screening includes a credit check plus rental history, income, and references.

## Location & Neighbourhood

82 Genest St is in Beechwood South, one of Ottawa's most walkable and bikeable neighbourhoods, a short walk from the cafés and shops on Beechwood Avenue.

- **Walk Score:** 94 — Walker's Paradise
- **Transit Score:** 58 — Good Transit (OC Transpo)
- **Bike Score:** 99 — Biker's Paradise
- About a 2 minute walk to the Ottawa River Pathway
- Minutes from Beechwood Cemetery's 160 acres of walking trails
- OC Transpo bus service into downtown Ottawa

## Upcoming Projects

- **Rockcliffe Collection** — Ottawa. Currently in design and permitting; not yet leasing.

## About Fortera Homes

Fortera Homes is an Ottawa developer grounded in hands-on construction expertise, building purpose-built rental homes designed for long-term residents. Core values include vision-driven design, premium build quality, strategic site selection, and trusted execution with full transparency.
